title: Sweep: acs predicate hardening (20 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: ACS predicate authoring and shared acsassert helpers: end-of-options handling, uniqueness-checked lookups, satisfiability, scoped selection. Amortised from 20 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.

prescriptions.text: PRESCRIPTION: Add `--end-of-options` before the SHA argument and validate it against ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ before any exec of git in ACS predicates — put it in a shared pkg/acsassert helper, not a per-cycle copy
PRESCRIPTION: Make the consumed-record lookup uniqueness-checked (fail on >1 record carrying the same id) in shared pkg/acsassert code so the next consume cycle inherits it

PRESCRIPTION: Add an (?i)(\d+)\s+of\s+(\d+) licensing axis to the ratio loop at go/acs/cycle1437/predicates_test.go:297 — proven to flag a fabricated '88 of 999' while leaving the shipped '15 of 167' green
PRESCRIPTION: Make TestC1437_003 require the evidence path unconditionally (predicates_test.go:210-213), or rename it so the predicate name stops overstating what it enforces

PRESCRIPTION: Queue the quadratic fenced-block rebuild in ClassifyBadVerdict (salvage_instrument.go:143-153) as a separate cycle; it must not be fixed here because ACS predicate 004 red-fails any classifier edit in cycle-1438
PRESCRIPTION: Widen ACS predicate TestC1444_006 and the context-fill-warn-threshold eval evidence command to -run 'TestProductionDeps.*ContextFill' so both wiring cases are selected
PRESCRIPTION: Parameterize the healthy-display-vocabulary predicate over every shipped manifest family so the ANY-family clause is falsifiable — it must be RED for agy before the manifest edit

PRESCRIPTION: Change go/acs/cycle1488/predicates_test.go:122 from acsassert.FileContains to acsassert.FileNotContains (exported at go/pkg/acsassert/assertions.go:81); TestC1492_003 then goes green on its own. Alternative: git rm --cached -r go/acs/cycle1488 go/acs/cycle1492 so only the green acs/cycle1495 package lands. Re-land the production diff unchanged — it is correct.
PRESCRIPTION: Pass the lane base (not projectRoot HEAD) to worktreeBaseTreeSHA at go/internal/core/phase_bindings.go:167, and add a divergent-base predicate case where ProjectRoot != worktree.
PRESCRIPTION: Make the EGPS/native ACS selection run every acs/cycle* package the commit STAGES, not only the current cycle's, so a red predicate can never land under a green gate.

PRESCRIPTION: Repair go/acs/cycle1510/predicates_test.go:162 to (?im)^#+\s*Amendments and repoint workspaceDir (:69-82) to select the candidate containing build-report.md, before this branch's payload lands on main

PRESCRIPTION: In go/acs/regression/cycle1515/predicates_test.go TestMain, replace the three `os.Exit(m.Run())` sites with `code := m.Run(); os.RemoveAll(dir); os.Exit(code)` so the deferred cleanup is not skipped by os.Exit — the leak is now on the standing acs-durable CI gate.

PRESCRIPTION: In go/acs/cycle1518/predicates_test.go TestC1518_004, parse `git status --porcelain -z` (NUL-delimited, never quoted) and check BOTH sides of a rename arrow, and drive the check off `git diff --name-only HEAD` rather than the working tree so it does not go vacuous after the ship commit.
PRESCRIPTION: Fix go/acs/cycle1517/predicates_test.go:221-223 to print err, drop the duplicated counts arg, and add a context deadline to the nested go test subprocess

PRESCRIPTION: File the pre-existing fail-open: evolve acs run emitted verdict=PASS ship_eligible=true total=0 while the inner go test exited 1; and the two pre-existing ./acs/... reds (acs/cycle10 TestC10_001, acs/cycle1019 TestC1019_004) reproduced on base fc2e4b14

PRESCRIPTION: Move the numeric report budget ABOVE the '## Reference Index (Layer 3, on-demand)' marker in agents/evolve-auditor.md:273, and re-point the doc-sync predicate at the DISPATCHED artifact (.evolve/runs/cycle-N/audit-prompt.txt) instead of agents/evolve-auditor-reference.md — the shape cycle-1517's eval already specified. Until then the persona half of cap-audit-report-length is undeliverable regardless of how green the doc-sync predicate is.
PRESCRIPTION: Bind continuation cycles' ACS scope to the ancestor's go/acs/cycle<ancestor> package so inherited acceptance predicates count toward the shipping cycle's red_count

PRESCRIPTION: Replace the marker-only success condition in assertDefaultSuiteTestsPass with the stricter in-repo shape already used at go/acs/cycle1529/predicates_test.go:135 — 'if err != nil || code != 0 { t.Fatalf(...) }' — and promote it into a shared acsassert helper so cycle predicate packages stop re-copying the lax form inherited from acs/cycle1544 and acs/cycle1546
PRESCRIPTION: Move or alias the cycle-scoped ACS predicates so `evolve acs suite --cycle <N>` grades a continuation lane's predicates instead of reporting cycle=0
PRESCRIPTION: evolve acs suite resolved 0 predicates when invoked from go/ yet still wrote verdict=PASS green=0 total=0 — a suite that resolved no predicates should refuse rather than emit PASS
